name: photo-tools
description: Photo and editorial image workflows, with mono-color research palette selection.

interface.shortDescription: Research palettes, editorial images, and photo posters.
interface.longDescription: Choose research graph colors with Mono-Color, create one/two-ink editorial images, or turn each travel photo into its own 4:3 rubber stamp journal poster. Uses Codex image generation for artwork and existing figure tools for scientific graphs.
defaultPrompt: Use $mono-color to pick colors for this research graph.
Use $mono-color to create a duotone poster.
Use $rubber-stamp-travel-poster to turn each uploaded photo into its own travel journal poster.
